methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The paper suggests a method of assessment of a DMS based on an indicator called Level of Coverage (LOC).

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents a distributed-monitoring-system coverage indicator (Level of Coverage, LOC) and a 6-criteria maturity-style EMIS assessment (basic/medium/high). LOC quantifies the fraction of yearly energy metered by the monitoring system, not energy performance; no EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised. EnPIs are mentioned only as a downstream objective enabled by the monitoring system.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The method uses 3 levels: 1 or basic, 2 or medium, 3 or high.

stage1.notes: LOC is a monitoring-coverage indicator, not an energy-performance (EnPI/EnB) model; EnPIs mentioned only as downstream goal. Ineligible as framework/tool without EnPI/EnB model content.
